QuestInfo.name: [Black Heaven] Memories of the Black Heaven
QuestInfo.0: Black Heaven is a smoking crater and peace has returned to Maple World. Yet Orchid and Athena Pierce are looking for you. What do they want now?
QuestInfo.1: Well, who was it? Orchid or Athena Pierce?
QuestInfo.2: You have found a trusty friend who will stand by your side. You are ready to face any challenges that come your way.
